annotations.title: Law firms in a large company's SEC filings

description: Use when the person asks which law firm or lawyers a large U.S. public company uses or has used, for example "Who is the law firm for Google?". Input: the company's name, a brand it owns or its stock ticker. Covers the 100 largest U.S. public companies by revenue. Returns the law firms that signed legal opinions filed with the company's SEC filings in the last 24 months, with the number of filings, the dates, a link to our copy of each opinion and the SEC original, and the firm's page in the lawyer directory where there is one. SEC legal opinions only (mostly stock and bond offerings): lawsuits and other legal work are not included. Read-only.

company.description: The company the person asked about: its name, a brand it owns (for example "Google" for Alphabet) or its stock ticker. The person's question as written also works.
